sql: SELECT university_id FROM university_year WHERE year = 2011 ORDER BY num_students DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.country_name FROM university AS T1 JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id WHERE T1.university_name = 'Harvard University'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM university_ranking_year AS T1 JOIN ranking_criteria AS T2 ON T1.ranking_criteria_id = T2.id JOIN university AS T3 ON T1.university_id = T3.id JOIN country AS T4 ON T3.country_id = T4.id WHERE T1.year = 2011 AND T2.criteria_name = 'Teaching' AND T1.score > 90 AND T4.country_name = 'United States of America'

SELECT T3.university_name FROM university_ranking_year AS T1 JOIN ranking_criteria AS T2 ON T1.ranking_criteria_id = T2.id JOIN university AS T3 ON T1.university_id = T3.id WHERE T1.year = 2011 AND T2.criteria_name = 'Teaching' AND T1.score = 98

SELECT T3.university_name FROM university_ranking_year AS T1 JOIN ranking_criteria AS T2 ON T1.ranking_criteria_id = T2.id JOIN university AS T3 ON T1.university_id = T3.id JOIN country AS T4 ON T3.country_id = T4.id WHERE T1.year = 2011 AND T2.criteria_name = 'Teaching' AND T1.score < 60 AND T4.country_name = 'United States of America'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM university AS T1 JOIN university_year AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.university_id JOIN country AS T3 ON T1.country_id = T3.id WHERE T3.country_name = 'Australia' AND T2.student_staff_ratio > 15 AND T2.year = 2011

SELECT CAST(T1.num_students * T1.pct_female_students AS REAL) / 100 FROM university_year AS T1 JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T1.year = 2011 AND T2.university_name = 'Stanford University'
SELECT num_students FROM university_year WHERE university_id = 268 AND year = 2013
SELECT country_name FROM country WHERE id = 66

SELECT T1.score FROM university_ranking_year AS T1 JOIN ranking_criteria AS T2 ON T1.ranking_criteria_id = T2.id JOIN university AS T3 ON T1.university_id = T3.id WHERE T3.university_name = 'University of Florida' AND T1.year = 2014 AND T2.criteria_name = 'N and S'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.university_name = 'University of Ottawa' THEN T1.num_students ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.university_name = 'Joseph Fourier University' THEN T1.num_students ELSE 0 END) FROM university_year AS T1 JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T1.year = 2013
SELECT score FROM university_ranking_year WHERE university_id = 68 AND year = 2015
SELECT id FROM country WHERE country_name = 'Cyprus'
SELECT AVG(score) FROM university_ranking_year WHERE university_id = 79 AND year BETWEEN 2013 AND 2015
SELECT COUNT(T2.criteria_name) FROM ranking_system AS T1 JOIN ranking_criteria AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.ranking_system_id WHERE T1.system_name = 'Shanghai Ranking'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.university_name FROM university_ranking_year AS T1 JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T1.score < 50

SELECT T2.university_name FROM university_year AS T1 JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id ORDER BY T1.num_students - CAST(T1.num_students * T1.pct_female_students AS REAL) / 100 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.num_students - CAST(T1.num_students * T1.pct_female_students AS REAL) / 100 FROM university_year AS T1 JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T1.year = 2011 AND T2.university_name = 'Emory University'
SELECT T2.year FROM university AS T1 JOIN university_ranking_year AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.university_id WHERE T1.university_name = 'Brown University' ORDER BY T2.score DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.university_name FROM university_year AS T1 JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T1.year = 2015 ORDER BY T1.num_students DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T3.country_name, CAST(T1.num_students * T1.pct_female_students AS REAL) / 100 FROM university_year AS T1 JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id JOIN country AS T3 ON T2.country_id = T3.id WHERE T1.year = 2011 AND T1.university_id = 23
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM university_ranking_year AS T1 JOIN ranking_criteria AS T2 ON T1.ranking_criteria_id = T2.id WHERE T1.score = 40 AND T2.criteria_name = 'Teaching'

SELECT DISTINCT T2.university_name FROM university_ranking_year AS T1 JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T1.year = 2015 AND T1.score < (SELECT AVG(score) * 0.28 FROM university_ranking_year WHERE year = 2015)
